reviews.x: I finally found it! I have been searching for a non irritating eye cream for my puffy eyes. This product has wonderful ingredients so I don't worry what I'm putting on my skin. I have used other organic or natural creams and they have all irritated my skin. After 5min I coud feel the skin getting firmer. My husband even noticed the improvement!

reviews.t: It feels weird at first but seems to be great. It has a feel like really airy gelatin
reviews.x: It's a way different consistency than I have ever put on my face.  It feels weird at first but seems to be great.  It has a feel like really airy gelatin...if that makes any sense.  It smells pleasant, definitely can smell the cucumber which is refreshing.  I have tried putting it not only around my eyes but also on the rest of my face and neck. So far so good...my skin is sensitive but no bad reaction thus far.  When you put it on, it feels moist and then feels sort of like its drying on your f

I need eye cream, but I kind of hate having it around my eyes.  This is light but noticeably moisturizing.  It feels cool going on.  The texture is great--not really a gel-gel, but more like a pudding.  Cucumber scented pudding.  I wear contacts and have pretty sensitive eyes and this doesn't bother my eyes at all.  After a week or so of using this day and night (sometimes patting on a little right when I get home from work as well), I felt as though it had firmed up my eye area a little--that t

reviews.t: the consistency is nice and it goes on smoothly
reviews.x: Skin Owl Organic Eye...all I can say is Wow!  I've only had this product for a short time and I can all ready see a difference..the consistency is nice and it goes on smoothly.. By keeping it in the refrigerator it keeps this product cool so it feels very refreshing when applied. It helps in reducing the puffiness of morning eyes and reduces the look of fine lines. If it helped with the dark circles I would have given it 5 stars..Very good product for the price.

I recently started using this eye product and so far I can say that I love the smell and the cooling feeling when I put it on. It isn't sticky either. It makes me look and feel more wide awake in the mornings. I used to look all puffy and half asleep all the time, not anymore! I also have a lot of problems with seasonal allergies and this does not have any negative effects with my allergy drops. Would recommend to a friend.

reviews.t: So far I really like the product
reviews.x: So far I really like the product.  It is a gel consistency and has a cooling effect when you put it on.  Drys quickly and adsorbs well.  Very moisturizing and my make up even seems to go better, ie. does not look dry around my eyes.  I also have pretty sensitive skin and after a week of use, my skin is tolerating it nicely.  I do wish it was packaged better, small jar and not easy to get out.

reviews.t: Excellent outcome. Compliments regarding smoothness around my eyes
reviews.x: Excellent outcome. Compliments regarding smoothness around my eyes. Have been asked if I have had a chemical peel. (Which I have not).  I have been using this product for more than 4 months  and the only thing Ido after the gel has dried is I use a bit of moisturizer on top of the gel to enable smooth concealer application. Skin Owl is  one of the best I have used.

reviews.t: but so far I really like this eye gel
reviews.x: I've only used this for a week, but so far I really like this eye gel. It's light, and my eyes looked refreshed after using it-- but don't use too much. A little goes a long way, so it really is a good value for the price. I also like the fact this is a chemical free eye product. A tip I learned is to keep this in the fridge to activate the cucumber enzymes.

This is everything it says it is...I will not be without....the texture is like jelly but goes on smooth with no piling...you can feel it tightening as it dries with no residue at all...and you can mix it with moisturizer or other serums and use all over the face...I LOVE this product

reviews.x: I was quite impressed with this product! I have never used something like this for my eye area before - it has a very different texture than I am used to but I really ended up loving it! This is kind of a cross between a gel and a cream, it has a really light texture like it's been whipped. It has a pleasant scent - you can definitely pick up on the cucumber and the aloe feels very soothing. It has a really nice and gentle cooling effect when you apply it and a little goes a pretty long way whic

reviews.t: What I did like the most was the cooling sensation and found that ...
reviews.x: This eye gel is very interesting. It is thick and clear, and I did feel some instant tightening of the skin around my eyes. But I wonder if it's just a sensation instead of actual tightening because I didn't actually see any difference. What I did like the most was the cooling sensation and found that helpful for those mornings when I was more tired or when I spent time outside in the sun. However, I had to use a moisturizer with it because it doesn't add any moisture on its own. It's for this r

I rarely leave reviews, but this product is excellent. I have dry, sensitive skin. I have tried pretty much all the major clean beauty eye creams, across all price points!!!, but none work or end up leaving my eye area feeling drier, or cause millia. Not with this. It can even be used on different areas of the face and has an immediate cooling, hydrating effect. This deserves way more hype!!! It's like a cool drink of water for my skin.  Also, this is a different formulation than their previous

reviews.t: At First I Hated It But Now I'm On Board
reviews.x: Confession: I am 31 years old and have not really gotten serious about eye cream. Now that I have a baby though, I was looking for something to lessen the damage of all those sleepless nights. I have sensitive skin, and was wary of unregulated chemicals and all that. Enter Skin Owl.  It feels like whipped gelatin, smells amazing, and stung a little when I put it on. It stuck to my eyelashes and at first, I hated it. But, I woke up the next morning and was like, whoa! I guess this stuff really wo

I got a sample of this in the mail and was excited to try it since I feel like most eye creams are too heavy or harsh for such delicate skin. This product is a clear jelly that goes on super smooth but has a powdery finish. My eye skin felt cooled but also immediately tightened. This product only has three ingredients which is pretty cool: just cucumber, aloe and hyaluronic acid (which helps skin retain moisture). I am starting to get fine lines around my eyes so I am glad to have found a natura

I absolutely love the Skin Owl Eye+! Because it is reasonably priced, I did not know that it would be such an effective eye cream. However, it lifts and tightens and smooths the skin under the eyes immediately. I am hoping that there is a cumulative effect over time as well. I keep mine in the frig, because the cold activates the cucumber, which increases it's effect. I just take a tiny dab and put it under my eye in the morning, and then a couple times throughout the day because it feels so ref

So first of all, I waited to try this product, on a busy day at work, where I prepped myself to the utmost positivity, but alas the power of the bright eyed and bushy tailed effect of this product lasted longer than my patience with co-workers, ha!  Very cool feeling upon applying , and the feeling that one's eyes were bright eyed lasted all day, I felt brighter too:)  A must! especially for work days;)

I am only giving this a 4 because I feel like a 5 is unattainable! This product is amazing!!! A friend recommended it and I tried to right away, I have tired puffy dark circled eyes and after three days of using the skin owl product it was like looking at a completely different person. If it wasn’t me who took the pictures I wouldn’t have believed it. Get this you wont regret it!!

I love the Skin Owl - Organic Eye+.  I use it exactly as described in the directions.  It gives you a slight tingling sensation and then a slight tightening up of the under up eye area that lasts and makes your eyes look refreshed. I wake up looking refreshed and not tired!  You can even put makeup on over top without issues.

This eye concentrate tightens and smooths fine lines and adds a lot of moisture to the eye area.  You can see and feel the area tightening up right after you apply it.  It has a nice cooling effect and really helps to depuff/shrink my new mum eye bags.  I am really happy with this product and will continue to use it.

This stuff is AMAZING! The consistency is a bit odd but it delivers a punch. It's hydrating, cooling & moisturizing.  Relieves puffiness, tightens eye area and gives it a lift. I won't be without this product!
Nice gel-like formula, Glides over skin, does not pull or tug. Eyes look more awake. Only been using for a few days too early to tell of lasting results, but love so far!

reviews.t: Won't leave home without it! My daughter was just ...
reviews.x: Won't leave home without it!  My daughter was just married and it was a very busy weekend with very little sleep - skin owl saved my life and my eyes!

reviews.x: Don't see any improvement. Stings a bit. Had to stop using the product after two weeks because of the irritation on the eye.
This is an amazing eye gel! I definitely suggest refrigerating it, because this gel feels so soothing and refreshing cold.

reviews.t: Love the clean fragrance and the way it feels when ...
reviews.x: Just started using this cream.  Love the clean fragrance and the way it feels when I put it on.  Absorbs quickly.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the cooling, refreshing sensation when applied, especially when kept in the refrigerator.
Many describe the texture as a light gel or jelly that goes on smoothly and absorbs well.
Several reviewers with sensitive skin report it is non-irritating and gentle around the eyes.
Multiple reviewers note a tightening effect and reduced puffiness or a more rested look.
A few reviewers mention the unusual texture feels strange at first or question whether the tightening is just a sensation.
